name: @levios/b2b
description: Levios B2B Module - Dealer management, bulk pricing, and credit accounts
author: Levios

scripts.resolve:aliases: yarn run -T tsc --showConfig -p tsconfig.json > tsconfig.resolved.json && yarn run -T tsc-alias -p tsconfig.resolved.json && yarn run -T rimraf tsconfig.resolved.json
scripts.build: yarn run -T rimraf dist && yarn run -T tsc --build && npm run resolve:aliases
